result.title: Learning to Reason with Predictive Gains for Generative Recommendation
result.summary: Reasoning-enhanced generative recommendation (GR) has attracted increasing attention for leveraging the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to improve next-item prediction. However, existing methods primarily optimize reasoning through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with rule-based rewards determined by final recommendation performance, which faces two key limitations: (i) unmeasured predictive contributions within reasoning, where the predictive contributions of individual reasoning steps are not directly reflected in optimization signals, and (ii) weakly discriminative learning signals within groups, where different reasoning trajectories within the group often receive indistinguishable rewards, limiting effective policy optimization. In this paper, we propose GainReason, a simple yet effective training framework that optimizes reasoning through Predictive Gain (PG). Specifically, PG measures changes in target Semantic ID (SID) log-likelihood induced by individual reasoning sentences, providing contribution-aware and discriminative rewards. We further theoretically establish the alignment between expected PG and the recommendation ranking objective. Building on this signal, we develop PG-based Reasoning Optimization (PGRO) to optimize reasoning generation with sentence-level rewards, supported by a custom causal attention mechanism for efficient PG computation. Additionally, an auxiliary PG-based Reasoning Utilization (PGRU) task adaptively strengthens reasoning-conditioned prediction to complement PGRO. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks demonstrate that GainReason consistently outperforms competitive baselines and achieves substantial performance gains from reasoning.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GainReason 训练框架，用「预测增益」（单句推理引起目标 Semantic ID 对数似然的变化）作为句子级、可区分的奖励来优化生成式推荐的推理，并配以因果注意力加速计算与辅助推理利用任务。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按句测量推理片段对目标预测贡献的做法，可为 LVR 中 latent/文本推理轨迹的贡献分配与「答案是否真正使用推理内容」的度量提供可核查的迁移线索，虽属推荐领域纯文本设定，仍需核查该增益是否只是相关性信号。
